Mapping workspace - implemented at a082bbed
|
|-- App
|   `-- createMappingServices()                 one browser service bundle
|       |-- diagrams: RevisionedDiagramService  -> [E]
|       |   |-- called by live + preview controllers
|       |   |-- owns editing contexts and CanvasHistory
|       |   |-- prepares content; navigates and exports history
|       |   `-- no disk store in browser runtime
|       `-- codeRepo: unconnectedCodeRepoService
|           |-- available: false
|           |-- file / directory / search / definitions contract
|           |-- git: commits / changes / diff / historical files
|           `-- every method rejects; existing source APIs remain
|
`-- MappingPocPage(services)
    `-- MappingServicesContext.Provider
        `-- MappingWorkspacePage
            |-- drafts[documentId]
            |   |-- name / representationId? / revisionId
            |   |-- savedName / savedScene / savedEdges
            |   |-- document / canvas           mirrored compatibility state
            |   |-- history?: CanvasHistoryRecord
            |   `-- busy / viewport? / focusBox?
            |-- MappingPocSelectionCanvas       constructs live controller
            |   `-- controllers[documentId]: MappingDocumentController -> [D]
            |       |-- injected DiagramService + opaque context handle
            |       |-- applyUpdate(...)        coordinates edits
            |       |-- getCanvasSnapshot()     canonical composition
            |       |   |-- scene.root: GridBox -> [A]
            |       |   |-- edges               logical content-node anchors
            |       |   `-- sections            no embedded DiagramContent
            |       |-- resolveDiagram(id)      detached logical-node view
            |       |-- exportHistory() / forkHistory()
            |       |-- getSnapshot()           compatibility read projection
            |       |   |-- contextId / canvasRevisionId / version
            |       |   |-- canUndo / canRedo
            |       |   |-- document: MappingGridDocument
            |       |   |   |-- scene.root
            |       |   |   |-- scene.contents[id]: Diagram -> [B]
            |       |   |   `-- edges / sections
            |       |   `-- canvas: MappingCanvasState
            |       |       |-- display          floating objects only
            |       |       |   `-- rootIds / nodes[id]: FloatingBox -> [C]
            |       |       |-- controls         selection / threads / surfaces
            |       |       `-- diagramViews     per-instance tree folds
            |       `-- nodes(): DisplayNode[]   derived public registry
            |           |-- id / version / childIds / expansion
            |           |-- grid: diagram | group
            |           |   `-- boxId / cell bounds / projected content
            |           `-- floating
            |               |-- pixel position + bounds
            |               |-- canvas | viewport coordinates
            |               `-- placement + FloatingBox value
            |-- ChangeSessionPreview
            |   `-- PreviewCanvas controller uses injected DiagramService
            |       `-- independent context; expanded, viewer-local folds
            |-- useAgentCanvasBridge(...)
            |   `-- snapshot includes history; apply calls applyUpdate()
            `-- capture(): MappingWorkspaceSnapshot
                |-- schemaVersion: 3 / projectId / activeDocumentId?
                `-- documents[]
                    |-- document identity + saved catalog identity
                    |-- name / revision / dirty-state baselines
                    |-- controller document + exported history
                    `-- canvas / viewport

Checkpoint changes -> onHistoryChange -> drafts.history
-> 150 ms coalescing -> queued workspace save; failures shown in page
Explicit catalog Save is separate from automatic workspace persistence.
Grid geometry and floating geometry remain separate.
Runtime handles and service instances are not serialized.

|       |-- layout + validation
|       `-- DiagramService.append -> one checkpoint -> notify readers
|-- Remaining document producers -> commitDocument(...)
|   `-- same checkpoint publication path
|-- updateCanvas(..., record = false)
|   `-- ordinary view updates do not append checkpoints
|-- undo / redo / reset
|   `-- DiagramService history delegation -> [E]
|       |-- migration H: service takes over controller-local history
|       `-- controller navigates then refreshes read projection
`-- Agent -> MCP -> HTTP backend
    `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService
        |-- exec staging controller receives snapshot history
        |-- live: CanvasSessionBridge -> browser poll/reply
        |   `-- applyUpdate(...); transact remains a compatibility adapter
        `-- ChangeSessionService -> [F]
            |-- captures saved documents and live drafts
            |-- uses injected server DiagramService
            `-- owns proposal mutation, history export and persistence

diagram-search reads saved/live materialized documents.
